evidence.detail: Corrected random_legal_deck() in decksite/league.py: old code `ds, _ = deck.load_decks(...)[0]` incorrectly indexed into the returned tuple before unpacking, causing a TypeError/ValueError; new code `ds, _ = deck.load_decks(...)` then `return ds[0]` is correct
Current code: ds, _ = deck.load_decks(where=where, having=having, order_by='RAND()', limit='LIMIT 1') — correct unpacking

triage.notes: The fix also added a parametrized test (test_random_legal_deck) covering both the empty-decks and single-deck cases.
triage.proposed_comment: Fixed in PR #14919 (commit 1b72b85a, merged 2026-08-22). The bug was a mis-indexed tuple unpack in random_legal_deck(); the corrected code is now in master.
